title: Lena and the Group Chat
author: Coral Galloway
blurb: Noor Eastwick, the new kid at a school built over something old, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
